A1_V3_V4e_smearing: q_c = 0.3/theta -> 0.15/theta. Reason (found on the ANALYTIC Uehling alone, no lattice number seen): the lattice q-table stops at q_lat = 0.6 (= 0.6/theta in m units, the species cutoff); with q_c = 0.3/theta the damping there is only e^-4, and the abrupt end makes the sin(qr) integral ring: the analytic smeared Uehling at r = 3 lambda_C came out 0.015 x the true value instead of ~1. With q_c = qmax/4 (damping e^-16) the ringing is gone. The same smearing is applied to the reference, as pre-registered. Thresholds unchanged.
